picture-pairs.name: Ngā takirua pikitia
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Kēmu Whakataurite mō te Mate Wareware: Ngā Takirua Pikitia
picture-pairs.h1: Ngā Takirua Pikitia: he Kēmu Whakataurite Mārire
picture-pairs.description: He kēmu whakataurite noa, he mārire hoki mō ngā tāngata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware. Ka noho kitea tonutia ngā pikitia nunui, kāore he matawā, he māka rānei, ā, māu anō e kōwhiri kia 4 ki te 12 ngā tāpa.
picture-pairs.short: Rapua ngā pikitia e rua e rite ana. Ka taea te waiho kia kitea tonutia ngā pikitia.
picture-pairs.players: 1, 2 rānei ngā tāngata, e noho tahi ana
picture-pairs.intro: Pāwhiritia tētahi pikitia, kātahi ka pāwhiri i tērā e taurite ana ki a ia. Ka noho kitea tonutia ngā pikitia i te tīmatanga, nō reira kāore he take kia maumahara ki tētahi mea. Ina hono ngā pikitia e rua, ka whiwhi paenga kōwhai me tētahi tohu tika.
howTo: Kōwhiria kia hia ngā tāpa hei whakamahi. He pai te tīmata mārire ki ngā tāpa e whā.
Pāwhiritia tētahi pikitia. Ka puta he paenga kōwhai ki taua pikitia.
Pāwhiritia te pikitia e rite ana te āhua. Ka noho tahi te takirua me tētahi tohu tika.
Mehemea he rerekē ngā pikitia e rua, kāore he raruraru. Pāwhiri anō i te wā e rite ana koe.
Whakakāhia "Ngā pikitia huna" mehemea anake he pai ki a kōrua tahi te takaro me ngā pikitia e anga whakamuri ana.
tips: Whakahuatia tahitia ngā ingoa o ngā pikitia me te kōrero tahi mō aua mea: "He kapu tī whero. He miraka tāu ki roto i tō tī?"
Waiho mā te tangata e tiakina ana e koe e pāwhiri, ahakoa he roa te wā. Tohua atu mā te maihao, kaua kē e pāwhiri māna.
Noho tonu ki ngā tāpa e whā i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho. He kōwhiringa noa iho te tāpiri tāpa, ehara i te taumata hei eke.
Whakamutua i te wā e ahuareka tonu ana. Kua ea te mahi ki te kēmu kotahi.

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei reira?
faq.a: Kāore. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he tino pai tonu te whakamutu i te haurua noa iho.

faq.q: He aha ngā pikitia ka noho tuwhera tonu ai?
faq.a: Mā te pupuri i ngā pikitia kia kitea tonutia, ka noho te kēmu hei titiro me te whakataurite noa iho, kaua kē hei maumahara. He marino ake tēnei ki te tini o ngā tāngata. Ka taea te huri ki ngā pikitia huna mā te pāwhiri kotahi mēnā e hiahia ana koe.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei, ā, me haina ahau?
faq.a: Āe, he koreutu tēnei, ā, kāore he pūkete, he haina, he tikiake rānei. Ka mahi i runga i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i te waea, i te papa, i te rorohiko rānei.

faq.q: Ka taea e mātou te whakamahi i ō mātou ake whakaahua whānau?
faq.a: Āe. Whakamātauria a Photo pairs, e āhei ai koe ki te kōwhiri whakaahua mai i tō pūrere. Ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua ki roto i tō pūtirotiro, kāore hoki e tukuna atu ki waho.

find-the-same.name: Rapua te mea rite
find-the-same.seoTitle: Rapua te Pikitia Rite: he Kēmu Māmā mō te Mate Wareware
find-the-same.description: Kotahi te pikitia kei runga, e rua ki te whā kei raro. Pāwhiritia te mea e rite ana. He kēmu pikitia marino, he koreutu hoki mō ngā tāngata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, kāore hoki he matawā.
find-the-same.short: Titiro ki te pikitia kei runga, ka pāwhiri ai i te mea rite kei raro.
find-the-same.intro: He pikitia kotahi kei runga o te mata. Kei raro iho e rua, e toru, e whā rānei ngā pikitia. Pāwhiritia te mea e rite ana. He kōwhiringa māmā noa i ia wā, me te nui o te wā mō te kōrerorero.
howTo: Kōwhiria kia rua, kia toru, kia whā rānei ngā pikitia hei whiriwhiri māu. Ko te rua te mea māmā rawa.
Tirohia tahitia te pikitia kei runga.
Pāwhiritia te pikitia rite kei raro. Ka tohua ki tētahi tohu tika me ētahi kupu mahana.
Mehemea ka pāwhiritia he pikitia rerekē, ka whakahuatia noatia e te kēmu tōna ingoa, ka tatari ai. Kia tau te haere.
Pāwhiritia "Pikitia panuku" i te wā e rite ana koe mō tētahi atu.
tips: Kōrerohia ia pikitia i mua i te kōwhiringa: ngā tae, ngā āhua, me ngā wāhi tērā pea ka kitea.
Kāore ngā kōwhiringa e rua i te "māmā rawa". Ko te whāinga he wā ahuareka, ehara i te whakamātautau.
Mehemea he uaua te pāwhiri, ka taea e te tangata te tohu noa atu mā te maihao, ā, māu e pāwhiri māna.

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei reira?
faq.a: Kāore. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he tino pai tonu te whakamutu i te haurua noa iho.

faq.q: Ka ahatia mehemea ka pāwhiritia he pikitia rerekē?
faq.a: Kāore he mea whakarihariha. Kāore he oro ngangau, he ripeka whero, he ru rānei. Ka whakahuatia noatia e te kēmu te ingoa o te pikitia i pāwhiritia, ka tatari ai mō te pāwhiritanga panuku.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei, ā, me haina ahau?
faq.a: Āe, he koreutu tēnei, ā, kāore he pūkete, he haina, he tikiake rānei. Ka mahi i runga i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i te waea, i te papa, i te rorohiko rānei.

shadow-match.name: Whakataurite ata
shadow-match.seoTitle: Kēmu Whakataurite Ata mō te Mate Wareware: Koreutu i te Ipurangi
shadow-match.h1: Whakataurite Ata: he Kēmu Pikitia Mārire
shadow-match.description: He ata pouri kei runga, e rua ki te whā ngā pikitia kei raro. Pāwhiritia te pikitia e hanga ana i taua ata. He kēmu whakataurite ata marino, he koreutu hoki mō te mate wareware, kāore he matawā.
shadow-match.short: Titiro ki te ata, ka pāwhiri ai i te pikitia e hanga ana i taua ata.
shadow-match.intro: He ngohe māhaki te whakataurite ata e mōhiotia ana mai i ngā pepa mahi, engari i konei he nunui ngā pikitia, kāore hoki he mea hei tā ki te pepa. He ata mārire kei runga o te mata, ā, e rua, e toru, e whā rānei ngā pikitia e tatari ana kei raro. Pāwhiritia te pikitia e hanga ana i taua ata. He māmā hoki te kōrerorero mō ngā hanga pērā i te paihikara, te marara, te kapu tī rānei.
howTo: Kōwhiria kia rua, kia toru, kia whā rānei ngā pikitia hei whiriwhiri māu. Ko te rua te mea māmā rawa.
Tirohia tahitia te ata. He aha tōna āhua? He roa, he porotaka rānei?
Pāwhiritia te pikitia e hanga ana i taua ata. Ka puta tōna ingoa ki raro iho i te ata.
Mehemea ka pāwhiritia he pikitia rerekē, ka whakahuatia noatia e te kēmu tōna ingoa, ka tatari ai. Kia tau te haere.
Pāwhiritia "Ata panuku" i te wā e rite ana koe mō tētahi atu.
tips: Whāia te paenga o te ata mā te maihao me te kōrero mō tōna āhua.
Mehemea he uaua ngā ata i tēnei rā, hurihia kē ki Rapua te mea rite, e ōrite tonu ai ngā pikitia ki reira.
Kōrerohia te pikitia ina kitea: "He marara pērā tā mātou i mua."

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei reira?
faq.a: Kāore. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he tino pai tonu te whakamutu i te haurua noa iho.

faq.q: He pai rānei te hono ata mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware?
faq.a: He mahi ngāwari, he mahi whakaahuru pea tēnei mā ētahi tangata, inarā i ngā wāhanga tōmua. He māmā ake te mōhio ki ngā āhua tēnā i ngā kupu. He mahi hei whakangahau, hei akiaki kōrero, ehara i te whakamātautau, ā, kāore hoki e rongoā, e whakapōturi rānei i te mate wareware. Mehemea ka whakararuraru, whakamātauria a Kimi i te Ōrite, titiro tahi noa rānei ki ngā whakaahua.

faq.q: Ka pēhea mēnā ka pāhia te whakaahua hē?
faq.a: Kāore he mea kino. Kāore he tangi tīwaha, he ripeka whero, he rūrū rānei. Ka whakahua noa te kēmu i te ingoa o te whakaahua i pāhia, ka tatari hoki kia pā anō koe.

faq.q: He kore utu rānei, ā, me haina rānei au ki roto?
faq.a: Āe, he kore utu katoa, ā, kāore he pūkete, he whakauru ingoa, he tikiake rānei. E mahi ana i roto i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko noa rānei.

sort-together.name: Kōmaka tahi
sort-together.seoTitle: Kēmu Kōmaka mō te Mate Wareware: Kōmaka Tahi
sort-together.h1: Kōmaka Tahi: he Mahi Kōmaka Whakaahua
sort-together.description: Pāhia tētahi whakaahua, kātahi ka pā ki te kete e tika ana māna: he kīhini, he māra rānei, he huarākau, he kararehe rānei. He mahi kōmaka marino, he kore utu hoki mā te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware.
sort-together.short: Whakatakotoria ia whakaahua ki tōna kete: te kīhini, te māra, me ētahi atu kaupapa.
sort-together.intro: He mahi māori, he mahi makona noa te kōmaka i ngā mahi o ia rā, pērā i te penapena kai hoko mai, te whakarite tōkena rānei. Pāhia tētahi whakaahua, kātahi ka pā ki te kete e tika ana mōna. Kāore he whāwhai, kāore hoki he huarahi hē.
howTo: Kōwhiria he kaupapa: he kīhini me te māra, he huarākau me te kararehe, he kāinga me te haereere rānei.
Pāhia he whakaahua. Ka puta he paenga koura ki te taha.
Pāhia te kete e tika ana māna. Ka neke te whakaahua ki taua kete.
Mehemea e tika ana kia haere ki te kete kē, ka whakamārama ata marie te kēmu, ka tatari hoki.
Kia kōmakatia katoatia ngā whakaahua, tirotirohia ngā kete i te taha o tō hoa.
tips: I te ao tūturu, he maha ngā wā kāore he whakautu hē. Mehemea ka kī tētahi nō te kīhini kē te kēne whakamākū tipu, pātaitia te take. Tērā pea ka rongo koe i tētahi kōrero whakamīharo.
Whakamahia ngā whakaahua hei tīmatanga kōrero: "He aha ōu mea i whakatipu ai i tō māra?"
He mahi pai anō hoki i waho atu o te mata te kōmaka taonga tūturu, pērā i te pune me te paoka, ngā pātene rānei i runga i te tae.

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei roto?
faq.a: Kāore. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, kāore hoki he mate. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he tino pai hoki te whakatā i te haurua o te mahi.

faq.q: He aha i whiriwhiria ai te kōmaka?
faq.a: He tokomaha te hunga e rata ana ki te kōmaka nā te mea he mahi whaihua, he mahi e taunga ana rātou. He māmā noa hoki te kōrerorero mō ngā whakaahua i a koutou e anga whakamua ana.

faq.q: He kore utu rānei, ā, me haina rānei au ki roto?
faq.a: Āe, he kore utu katoa, ā, kāore he pūkete, he whakauru ingoa, he tikiake rānei. E mahi ana i roto i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko noa rānei.

picture-puzzle.name: Panga whakaahua
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Panga Ngāwari mō te Mate Wareware: e 4, e 9 rānei ngā Pihi
picture-puzzle.description: He panga ā-ipurangi ngāwari mā te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware: e 4, e 9 rānei ngā pihi nunui, ka noho kitea tonu te whakaahua katoa, ā, ka pā noa ki ngā pihi e rua hei whakawhitiwhiti.
picture-puzzle.short: Pāhia ngā pihi e rua hei whakawhitiwhiti kia tūhono anō te whakaahua katoa.
picture-puzzle.intro: Ka kotia tētahi whakaahua ātaahua kia whā, kia iwa rānei ngā pihi nunui, ka whakaranua hoki. Ka noho kitea tonu te whakaahua katoa hei aratohu. Pāhia tētahi pihi, kātahi ka pā ki tētahi atu, ka tauwhiti hoki ō rāua tūranga. Kāore he take ki te tō me te toia o ngā pihi.
howTo: Kōwhiria he whakaahua me ngā pihi e 4, e 9 rānei. He pai ngā pihi e whā hei tīmatanga ngāwari.
Titiro ki te whakaahua katoa kei runga.
Pāhia tētahi pihi, kātahi ka pā ki te wāhi e tika ana mōna. Ka whakawhitiwhiti aua pihi e rua.
Ka puta he tohu tika iti ki ngā pihi kua tū tika.
Kia oti te whakaahua katoa, me whakanui tahi, kātahi ka kōwhiri i tētahi atu.
tips: Mā te nuinga, he māmā kē te pā noa ki ngā pihi e rua hei whakawhitiwhiti tēnā i te toia haere.
Kōrerohia te whakaahua i a ia e tūhono haere ana: "Koinei te tuanui whero."
He tino mahi ātaahua anō hoki i runga tēpu te panga rākau tūturu whai pihi nunui e 12 ki te 24.

faq.q: Me toia rānei e au ngā pihi?
faq.a: Kāore. Pāhia tētahi pihi, kātahi ka pā ki tētahi atu, ka whakawhiti ō rāua tūranga. He māmā ake tēnei mō te ringaringa tūporepore, i runga mata iti rānei.

finish-the-saying.name: Whakaotihia te kīwaha
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Whakaotihia te Kīwaha: he Kēmu Whakataukī mā te Hunga Pakeke
finish-the-saying.description: He kīwaha Amerika e mōhiotia whānuitia ana kua ngaro te kupu whakamutunga, pērā i a "A penny saved is a penny ___". Pāhia he kōwhiringa, whakaatuhia rānei te mutunga, kātahi ka kōrerorero tahi.
finish-the-saying.short: Whakaotihia ngā kīwaha taunga i te taha o tō hoa, kātahi ka kōrerorero tahi.
finish-the-saying.intro: He maha ngā kīwaha tawhito kua roa e mōhiotia ana puta noa i te koiora o te tangata. E whakaatu ana ia kāri i tētahi kīwaha taunga kua ngaro te kupu mutunga, e toru ngā kōwhiringa, me tētahi pātene "Whakaatuhia te mutunga". I muri i te mutunga, he pātai ngāwari e tono ana i te kōrero.
howTo: Pānuihia ngātahitia te kīwaha.
Pāhia te kupu hei whakaoti, pāhia rānei a "Whakaatuhia te mutunga".
Pānui anō i te kīwaha katoa, ka kōrerorero hoki mā te whakamahi i te pātai whakaoho kōrero.
Pāhia a "Kīwaha e whai ake nei" ina reri koe.
tips: Pānui māhorahora, ā, me whakatā poto i mua i te kupu whakamutunga. He maha ngā wā ka whakahuatia e te tangata i mua i tō mutunga.
Mehemea he rerekē te mutunga ka puta mai i te tangata, me koa tonu ki tērā. Tērā pea he rerekē ngā kōrero i tēnā whānau, i tēnā takiwā.
I roto i te rōpū, mā tētahi e pānui, ā, mā te katoa e kī ngātahi i te mutunga.

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei roto?
faq.a: Kāo. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he huarahi tino pai te mutu i waenga pū hei whakaoti.

faq.q: Ka pēhea mēnā ka kōwhiria e mātou he kupu rerekē?
faq.a: Ka whakaaturia e te kēmu te otinga noa, kātahi ka neke ki te kōrerorero. Kāore he māka, ā, he pai noa iho tētahi whakautu rerekē.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei tēnei, ā, me rēhita rānei ahau?
faq.a: Āe, he koreutu, kāore hoki he heipūkeretanga pūkete, he takiuru, he tango mai rānei. Ka mahi tonu i roto i te tirotiro tukutuku i runga i te waea, i te papa, i te rorohiko rānei.

word-search.name: Rapu kupu pū rahi

word-search.short: He pū rahi, he torutoru noa ngā kupu, he whakapae, he poutū anake. Ka taea hoki te tā ki te pepa.
word-search.intro: He mātiti ririki me ngā pū nunui, he torutoru noa iho ngā kupu, ā, he whakapae, he poutū anake te pānui. Pāwhiria te pū tuatahi o tētahi kupu, kātahi tōna pū whakamutunga. He pai ake te pepa ki a koe? Tāngia he panga hou ki te pā kotahi noa.

Titiro ki te rārangi kupu. Ka pānuitia ngā kupu mai i te taha mauī ki te taha matau (whakapae), mai i runga rānei ki raro (poutū).
Pāwhiria te pū tuatahi o te kupu, kātahi ka pā ki tōna pū whakamutunga.
Ka miramiratia te kupu ka kitea, ā, ka whakawāteahia mai i te rārangi.
Pāwhiria "Tāia tēnei panga" hei tākaro i runga pepa mā te pene rākau, mā te pene tohu rānei.
tips: Tohua he kupu kei te rārangi, kātahi ka kimi tahi ai i tōna pū tuatahi.
I runga pepa, he māmā ake te pupuri i te pene tohu miramira i te pene rākau.
Kōrerohia ngā kupu o te kaupapa. He huarahi noa ngā kupu mō ngā hua rākau hei whakaoho mahara mō te kohi hua, te tunu kai, te haere rānei ki ngā mākete.

faq.a: Āe. Pāwhiria "Tāia tēnei panga" hei tā i te mātiti o nāianei ki ngā momotuhi nunui, me te rārangi kupu kei raro tonu iho. He rerekē ngā panga hou katoa.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei tēnei, ā, me rēhita rānei ahau?

coloring.name: Whārangi tae
coloring.seoTitle: Whārangi Whakanoho Tae Koreutu mō te Hunga Pakeke Whai Mate Wareware
coloring.description: He whārangi tae māmā mō te hunga pakeke, he rahi ngā wāhanga: pāwhiria he tae, kātahi ka pā ki te pikitia. Kāore he mōrearea paru, kāore he tae hē, ā, ka taea ia whārangi te tā mō te koreutu.
coloring.short: Pāwhiria he tae, kātahi ka pā ki tētahi wāhanga o te pikitia. Ka taea hoki ngā whārangi te tā.
coloring.intro: He whārangi me ngā āhua nunui, māmā hoki: he puāwai i roto i te kōhua, he whare, he kapu tī, he pūrerehua, he kaipuke rā hoki. Pāwhiria he tae, kātahi ka pā ki tētahi wāhanga o te pikitia hei whakakī. Kāore rawa he tae hē.
howTo: Kōwhiria he whārangi.
Pāwhiria he tae. Kua tuhia te ingoa o ia tae ki runga.
Pāwhiria tētahi wāhanga o te pikitia hei whakakī ki taua tae.
Whakarerekētia ōu whakaaro i ngā wā katoa mā te whakakī anō.
Pāwhiria "Tāia tēnei whārangi" kia whiwhi whārangi wātea hei whakanoho tae mā te pene tae, pene tohu rānei.
tips: Mēnā he taumaha rawa te kōwhiri i roto i te huinga katoa, hoatu kia rua noa ngā tae hei kōwhiringa māna.
E pai ana ngā rākau tawa me ngā rā kahurangi. Ko te harikoa ki te mahi tahi me ngā tae te mea nui, ehara i te pono o te āhua.
He tino pai ngā whārangi kua tāia ki te whakamahi me ngā pene tohu mātotoru, ngā tioka tae rānei, he māmā ake te pupuri.

faq.q: He matawā rānei, he māka rānei kei roto?
faq.a: Kāo. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he huarahi tino pai te mutu i waenga pū hei whakaoti.

faq.q: He tamariki rawa rānei ēnei whārangi?
faq.a: I tāia e mātou he mea marino, he mea māmā, ehara i te pikitia pakiwaituhi, kia tau ai mō te hunga pakeke. Nā ngā āhua nunui i māmā ai te whakanoho tae, me te pupuri tonu i te mana o te pakeke.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei tēnei, ā, me rēhita rānei ahau?
faq.a: Āe, he koreutu, kāore hoki he heipūkeretanga pūkete, he takiuru, he tango mai rānei. Ka mahi tonu i roto i te tirotiro tukutuku i runga i te waea, i te papa, i te rorohiko rānei.

conversation-cards.name: Kāri kōrero
conversation-cards.seoTitle: He Whakaoho Kōrerorero mō te Hunga Whai Mate Wareware: Kāri Pikitia
conversation-cards.description: He kāri pikitia me ngā whakaoho kōrero mārire mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware: kāore he patapatai mōhiohio, kāore he whakautu tika motuhake. Whakamahia i te mata, tāia rānei te huinga katoa.
conversation-cards.short: He kāri pikitia me ngā pātai mārire, tuwhera noa. Kāore he patapatai.
conversation-cards.intro: Kei ia kāri tētahi pikitia e mōhiotia whānuitia ana me tētahi pōwhiri mārire ki te kōrero, pēnei i "Ko tēhea tō tino huarere?" Kāore he whakautu tika motuhake, kāore hoki he mea me maumahara tonu. Kōwhiria he kaupapa, whakaranua katoatia rānei.
howTo: Kōwhiria he kaupapa, waiho rānei ki "Ngā kāri katoa".
Pānuitia te pātai kia rangona te reo, ā, titiro tahi ki te pikitia.
Whakarongo, kōrerohia ōu ake whakaaro, ā, waiho te kōrero kia rere noa.
Pāwhiria "Kāri e whai ake nei" ina rite koe, noho rānei ki tētahi kāri mō te wā e hiahia ana koe.
Pāwhiria "Tāia ngā kāri katoa" hei tapahi i tētahi huinga pepa.
tips: Whakautua anō te pātai e koe anō. Mā reira e rite ai ki te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero tūturu, kaua ki te uiuinga tūtohu.
Whāia te rere o te kōrero, kaua ko ngā tino meka. Mēnā ka huri ngā kōrero taipitopito, he pai noa iho tēnā.
Ki te pā te kāri ki tētahi kaupapa pōuri, whakaaetia te kare-ā-roto, kātahi ka āta neke mārire ki tētahi atu kāri.

faq.q: He aha i kore ai he pātai pēnei i "Kei te maumahara koe ki…?"?
faq.a: Ko ngā pātai whakamātau i te mahara, ka rite pea ki tētahi whakamātautau kura, ā, ka puta pea he whakamā. Mā ngā pōwhiri tuwhera pēnei i "Kōrerohia mai mō…" ka āhei te katoa ki te uru mai, ahakoa te nui, te iti rānei o ngā mea e maumaharatia ana e rātou.

faq.q: Ka taea e au ngā kāri te tā?
faq.a: Āe. Mā te pāwhiri i "Tāia ngā kāri katoa" ka tāngia te huinga katoa ki ngā momotuhi nunui, he maha ngā kāri ki ia whārangi, kua rite hei tapahi māu.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei tēnei, ā, me rēhita rānei ahau?
faq.a: Āe, he koreutu tēnei, kāore hoki he pūkete, he rēhita, he tikiake rānei. Ka mahi tonu i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga waea kairangi, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei.

photo-pairs.name: Ngā takirua whakaahua
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Hangaia he Tākaro Whakataurite mai i ngā Whakaahua Whānau
photo-pairs.h1: Ngā Takirua Whakaahua: Whakatauritea ō Ake Whakaahua
photo-pairs.description: Hurihia ō whakaahua whānau hei tākaro whakataurite ngāwari. Kōwhiria kia 2 ki te 6 ngā whakaahua mai i tō pūrere; ka noho tonu ki tō pūtirotiro, ā, e kore rawa e tukuna atu.
photo-pairs.short: Kōwhiria ō ake whakaahua hei whakataurite. Kāore he mea e tukuna atu.
photo-pairs.players: Tokorua ngā tāngata, e noho tahi ana
photo-pairs.intro: Kōwhiria kia rua ki te ono ngā whakaahua mai i tō waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei, ā, ka huri hei tākaro whakataurite whai whakaahua nui, māmā hoki te kite atu. Ka whakaaturia ngā whakaahua ki roto anake i tēnei whārangi. E kore e tukuna atu, e tiakina, e tuwhaina rānei, ā, ka ngaro katoa ina kati koe i te whārangi.
howTo: Pāwhiritia "Kōwhiri whakaahua" ka kōwhiri ai i ētahi whakaahua kia rua ki te ono.
Ka puta rua ia whakaahua. Pāwhiritia tētahi, kātahi ka pāwhiri i tōna takirua.
Kōrerohia ia whakaahua i a kōrua e kite ana.
Ina mutu koe, katia te whārangi, pāwhiritia rānei "Whakakore whakaahua". Kāore he mea e pupuritia.
tips: Kōwhiria he whakaahua mārama o ngā mea harikoa, mea taunga hoki: he mōkai, he māra, he wāhi e manakohia ana, he rā marena rānei.
He māmā ake pea ngā whakaahua o ngā wāhi me ngā taonga i ngā kanohi tangata, ā, ka karo hoki i te pēhanga ki te whakaingoa tāngata.
Waihotia ngā whakaahua o te hunga kua mate mēnā ka puta ohorere mai pea te pōuri, engari anō mēnā e mōhio ana koe he whakamārie kē te hua.

faq.q: Ka tukuna atu rānei aku whakaahua ki tētahi wāhi?
faq.a: Kāo. Ka pānuitia e te whārangi ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe i roto tonu i tō pūtirotiro, ā, ka whakaaturia ki tō mata whakaata. Kāore e tukuna mai ki a mātou, ki tētahi atu rānei, ā, ka ngaro katoa ina kati koe, ina whakahou rānei i te whārangi.

faq.q: He matawā, he māka rānei kei roto?
faq.a: Kāo. Kāore he karaka, he māka, he tatau nekehanga, he hinga rānei. Ka taea e kōrua te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa, ā, he huarahi pai noa iho te mutu i waenganui pū.

faq.q: Ka taea e au te tiaki i te tākaro mō tētahi atu wā?
faq.a: Kāore e taea i te pūtirotiro, he mea āta whakarite kia kaua rawa he kōrero tūmataiti e tiakina. Ka taea e te taupānga koreutu o Golden Moments mō te iPhone me te iPad te pupuri i ētahi kape whakaahua i kōwhiria ki runga i tō pūrere.

picture-bingo.name: Pingo whakaahua
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Pingo Whakaahua mā te Hunga Kaumātua e Noho Tahi ana me te Mate Wareware: Tāngia
picture-bingo.description: He pingo whakaahua koreutu ka taea te tā mā ngā rōpū tiaki mahara me ngā rōpū kaumātua, me tētahi kaiwhakahua nui i runga mata. He whakaahua nunui me ngā kupu, e 9, e 16 rānei ngā tapawhā, kāore he whakaritenga kia mōhio ki te pānui.
picture-bingo.short: He kāri pingo whakaahua ka taea te tā me tētahi kaiwhakahua mata nui mā ngā rōpū.
picture-bingo.players: He rōpū o te 2 ki te 30 tāngata
picture-bingo.intro: He tākaro pingo matarau e whakamahi ana i te whakaahua kaua i te nama, kia kore ai e hiahiatia te pānui i ngā kupu moroiti. Tāngia he huinga kāri motuhake, kātahi ka whakamahi i te kaiwhakahua i te mata hei whakaatu nui i ia whakaahua ki runga pouaka whakaata, rorohiko pona, papa rorohiko rānei.
howTo: Kōwhiria kia 9, kia 16 rānei ngā tapawhā mō ia kāri, me te rahi o te hunga tākaro.
Pāwhiritia "Tāngia ngā kāri". He rerekē ia kāri.
Whakatūwherahia te kaiwhakahua ki runga mata nui. Pāwhiritia "Whakaahua e whai ake nei" hei whakaatu i ia whakaahua me tōna ingoa.
Ka uhia e ngā kaiwhakataetae te whakaahua e taurite ana ki runga i tā rātou kāri ki te moni kapa, pātene, tohu rānei.
Ka whakanuia te hunga katoa ka whakaoti i tētahi rārangi, i te kāri katoa rānei. Kāore he tangata e hinga i tēnei putanga: tākaro tonu kia whai rārangi te katoa.
tips: Whakamahia he tohu nunui pēnei i ngā poro tākaro tiaki, taupoki pātara rānei. He uaua pea te kohi i ngā pātene nohinohi.
Whakahuatia te ingoa o te whakaahua ka kōrero ai mōna: "He poti tere. Ko wai kua eke kē ki runga waka moana?"
Whakanohoia te hunga he uaua ki te kite ki te wāhi e tata rawa ana ki te mata, ka whakarite āwhina hoki mā te hunga e hiahia ana.
Kua nui noa atu ngā tapawhā e iwa mā te nuinga o ngā rōpū. Me noho te wā tākaro ki te tata ki te 20 ki te 30 meneti.

faq.q: Me pēhea taku whakahaere i te pingo whakaahua ki tētahi kāinga manaaki kaumātua?
faq.a: Tāngia kia kotahi te kāri mō ia kaiwhakataetae, whakanohoia te kaiwhakahua ki te mata nui rawa atu kei a koe, ka whakahua mārie ai i ngā whakaahua me te whakaingoa i ia mea. Tākaro tonu kia whai rārangi te katoa, kia kore ai tētahi e mahue.

faq.q: He koreutu rānei te tā?
faq.a: Āe. Tāngia ngā kāri e hiahiatia ana e koe, i ngā wā e hiahia ana koe, māu anō, mā tētahi rōpū rānei.

faq.q: Ka taea rānei e te tangata te tākaro me te kore pānui kupu?
faq.a: Āe. He whakaahua nui kei ia tapawhā, me tōna ingoa kei raro iho mā te hunga e pai ana ki ngā kupu.

calm-breathing.name: Te whakangā mārie
calm-breathing.seoTitle: He Wā Whakangā Mārie mā te Hunga Kaumātua me ngā Kaitiaki
calm-breathing.description: He wā whakangā ata noho hei wheako tahi: ka whakarahi, ka whakaiti tētahi porowhita ngāwari mō ngā hā e ono. Māu anō e tīmata, ā, ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa.
calm-breathing.short: He porowhita ata noho hei hā tahi atu. Tīmatahia, whakamutua rānei i te wā e pai ana ki a koe.
calm-breathing.intro: I ētahi wā, ko te ngohe tino pai rawa atu ko te whakatā noa iho i runga i te rangimārie. Pāwhiritia "Tīmata", kātahi ka whakahā ki roto i te whakarahi ake o te porowhita, ka whakahā ki waho i te whakaiti iho. Kōwhiria he tere whakangā māmā ake, tere ake rānei. Ehara tēnei i te maimoatanga hauora, he wā rangimārie noa iho hei noho tahi atu.
howTo: E noho whakamārie taha ki te taha.
Kōwhiria he tere: he ata haere, he ngāwari rānei.
Pāwhiritia "Tīmata". Whakahā ki roto i te whakarahi ake o te porowhita, ā, ki waho i te whakaiti iho.
Ka mutu noa iho i muri i ngā hā e ono, pāwhiritia rānei "Whakamutu" i ngā wā katoa e hiahia ai koe.
tips: Kia mau ki ngā ringaringa, whakatakotoria rānei he ringa ki runga i te ringa o te tangata mēnā e pai ana ki a ia.
Kaua rawa e tohe. Mēnā he pai ake ki a ia te mātakitaki noa iho, he pai tonu tērā.
Mēnā he raru whakangā tō tētahi, whakangā noa iho, ā, mātakitaki kau atu ki te porowhita. Me kōrero ki tētahi tākuta mō ngā āwangawanga whakangā.

faq.q: He korikori whakangā ā-rongoā tēnei?
faq.a: Kāo. He whakatā māmā noa iho tēnei e wātea ana hei kimi marino, hei noho tahi hoki. Ehara tēnei i te maimoatanga mō te manawa pā, mō tētahi atu mate rānei. Kōrero atu ki tētahi tākuta mō ngā āwangawanga hauora.

faq.q: Ka neke rānei te porowhita me te kore e tīmatahia e au?
faq.a: Kāo. Kāore he mea e neke kia pā rā anō koe ki Tīmata, ā, ka mutu i muri i ngā hā e ono, ina pā rānei koe ki Whakamutu. Mehemea kua whakaritea tō pūrere kia whakaiti i ngā koringa, ka huri ngā kupu me te kore e nui haere te porowhita.

faq.q: He kore utu rānei, ā, me rēhita rānei au?
faq.a: Āe, he kore utu, ā, kāore he pūkete, he rēhita, he tikiake rānei. Ka mahi i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga i te waea, i te papa, i te rorohiko rānei.
